hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.lua|*.py|*.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx|*.rs|*.go|*.c|*.h|*.cc|*.cpp|*.hpp|*.sh|*.bash|*.vim|*.nix) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"code-clarity reminder: keep comments small and explicit. Module/class/library scopes get a short first-impression overview. See the code-clarity skill."}}' ;; esac; }
